🇺🇸🇨🇳 The nuclear gap is closing: Trump says China's 600 warheads will catch America's arsenal within 10 years

Run the numbers Trump gave reporters on Friday, about 600 Chinese warheads against roughly 4,000 American ones, and Beijing still has a long climb.

Rob Spalding would rather people looked somewhere else.

The retired Air Force general, who served on Trump's first National Security Council, doubts either side would ever risk a nuclear exchange, and he says that pushes the real contest into trade, finance, politics and digital networks. Rob on where that leaves the country:

"So we haven't done anything to really prepare for fighting at home."

He means it literally as well, because he says American bases still lack the sensors and basic wiring to stop the cheap drones Russia and Ukraine trade every day.

Ten years is plenty of time to fix that, and it costs a lot less than matching China silo for silo.

@robert_spalding @WeTheBrandon
